rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow, pleadings-bound affirmance applying Heck/Balisok to bar this particular request for declaratory/injunctive relief because, as framed, success would necessarily imply the invalidity of an outstanding conviction, while emphasizing Wilkinson/Skinner leave room for properly cabined prospective suits. Barrett or Roberts are the most probable authors given their central “as-pleaded/necessary-implication” framing, with a meaningful chance of a Sotomayor- or Kagan-led dissent (and possible Gorsuch writing) pressing a decree-focused, tailoring-friendly approach.
